{{Quote|I haven't been this tired since we hiked to the top of the Triplehorn mountains back on Alderaan.|Zak Arranda|<ref name="pp" />}}
The '''Triplehorn mountains''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="pp" /> Its snow-capped peaks<ref name="RoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> bordered the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> At some point before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of Alderaan by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the siblings [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] hiked to the top of the Triplehorn mountains, which the former described as an exhausting experience.<ref name="pp" />
